biggest_catch: The bank has upgraded the offer to $100 per referral, but the annual cap stayed at $500 — so only 5 paid referrals per year (down from 10 at the old $50 amount).
catches: Cap: up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year.
The Referred Person must complete a $250+ direct deposit or 10 debit purchases within 60 days of opening.
Referral must register for the program and submit a valid email for both parties; only one Referrer is credited per Referred Person.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Commonwealth Bank's official site (fcbanking.com/personal/refer-a-friend/) publishes full Refer-A-Friend terms and conditions.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each individual or business referred who registers, opens a new checking account, and completes the requirements, up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) per calendar year.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register for the program (online at fcbanking.com/referafriend, online banking, mobile app, branch, or ReferLive app) and submit valid email addresses for both parties; the Referred Person registers via the referral link/email/social offer, agrees to the terms, and opens a new personal or business checking account. Personal Account Qualification: within 60 days of opening, complete one (1) direct deposit of $250+ OR ten (10) qualifying debit card purchases.

c4.evidence: Timing: reward cards are issued after the referral completes the requirements; card delivery timing is not stated beyond program completion.

eligibility: First Commonwealth Bank customers (referrers must register for the program); referrals must not already have a First Commonwealth checking account.
notes: Current offer is $100/referral (upgraded from the earlier $50 amount); only 5 paid referrals per year at the $500 cap. FAQ also confirms business referrals: $100 referrer / $200 business.
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of $100.00 Mastercard Reward Card.
payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each individual or business referred.
payout_value_note: Mastercard Reward Card (gift card), not cash.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral registration is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s4.note: Cap: up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated in the official terms: register online at fcbanking.com/referafriend, through online/mobile banking, in-branch, or via the ReferLive app; submit a valid email address for both the Referrer and each Referred Person.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: register via the referral link; agree to the terms; open a new personal or business checking account; within 60 days complete one (1) direct deposit of $250+ or ten (10) qualifying debit card purchases.

steps: Register for the referral program at fcbanking.com/referafriend (or online banking, app, branch, or ReferLive app).
Submit valid email addresses for yourself and each friend referred.
Friend registers via the referral link, agrees to terms, and opens a new checking account ($50 min for Hometown Checking).
Friend completes within 60 days: one $250+ direct deposit or 10 qualifying debit card purchases.
You receive a $100 Mastercard Reward Card (max 5 per calendar year).
timing: Reward cards issued after the referral completes the requirements; delivery timing not published.
